## Chapter1 .Letter to Shareholders

## Market Environment

The  post-epidemic  era  has  brought  a  wave  of  global  digital  transformation,  prompting  the  rapid development  of  communications  and  digital  tools  and  the  emergence  of  new  economies  such  as vertical applications and metaverse. The 5G network is not only a critical infrastructure for Taiwan to move toward intelligentization. Various 5G+AIoT applications such as smart transportation and energy have also become essential tools for promoting ESG and sustainable cities. Since the telecom industry is highly competitive, APT has integrated its operation strategy and is pursuing a dual-track approach with 5G+ESG to flexiblyrespond to the 5G market through multiple partnerships.

APT(Asia  Pacific  Telecom  Co.,  Ltd.)  officially  launched  the  3.5GHz  5G  co-frequency  and  conetwork operation on August 12, 2021, providing users with 5G network services with the optimal 80MHz  bandwidth  while  reducing  power  consumption  through  spectrum  sharing  to  achieve sustainable development goals. The digital infrastructure underpins the development of the digital convergence  application  ecosystem. APT  launches  innovative  applications  with  high  quality  5G network to boost the telecommunications business. At the same time, we will work with our partners in  the  ecosystem  to  promote  the  performance  of  digital  economy  operations,  leverage  our  core strengths in information and communications, accelerate digitization and intelligentization, implement ESG sustainable management, and realize the expectations of our stakeholders.

## Financial Performance

With the joint efforts of all our colleagues, APT achieved a consolidated total revenue of NT$12.647 billion in 2021, a pre-tax EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization) of NT$524 million, a net profit after tax of -NT$5.374 billion respectively, and an EPS of -NT$1.35.

## Business Development

APT continues to consolidate its telecom business, optimize the quality of its network and voice services, and provide 5G high-speed Internet access under a 3.5GHz co-frequency and co-network architecture. We have also signed a frequency transfer agreement with Chunghwa Telecom for the 900MHz band. After approval by the competent authorities, Chunghwa Telecom will provide CSFB voice platform services for APT customers, further upgrading the customer experience.

In the face of the unstoppable 5G digital convergence wave, APT launched a wide range of innovative 5G value-added applications for its consumers. Gt TV, APT's OTT service, has partnered with the world's largest Chinese music distributor, JSJ Music, to host a number of 5G+4K online and offline multi-view  concerts.  So  far,  25  groups  of  artists  have  performed,  including  the  Golden  Melody Award-winner, Eve Ai, and music bands such as Quarterback and The Chairman. Nearly 1,900 hours of video was watched, setting a new benchmark for Taiwan's 5G entertainment industry. APT has also joined hands with broadband operators to launch mobile and fiber dual-play services to meet the demand for round-the-clock Internet access. At the same time,    APT has integrated multiple smart terminals and applications to launch innovative value-added applications such as Fun at Home and

Safe at Home, and laying out a 5G smart home ecosystem.

APT integrates cross-industry ecosystem partners to promote ICT solutions and IoT applications to help enterprises and governments transform digitally and expand new economic dynamics. In terms of  smart  transportation,  we  cooperate  with  Taipei  City,  Kinmen  County,  and  Penghu  County governments to use AI image recognition technology to promote event detection, pedestrian  and vehicle flow analysis, and introduce technological detection tools for technical enforcement. As for smart energy, the Company has the No. 1 market share in the air quality sensor IOT network sector and so far has assisted as many as seven county and municipal governments in Taiwan to implement the network. In addition, the Company has partnered with FHNet and LITEON Technology to build the industry's first 5G mmWave smart pole, creating a new milestone in smart applications.

APT is focusing on a 5G enterprise network and integrating the hardware and equipment resources of Hon Hai Technology Group. Together with its subsidiary FHNet, we are building the industry's first SA (Standalone) architecture for the smart medical experimental field. APT also set up the first domestic, commercial 5G O-RAN network at the Kaohsiung Exhibition Hall, the first national smart venue  with  a  5G  dedicated  frequency  network  launched  in  Taiwan  to  demonstrate  multiple applications such as smart entertainment services.

As the pandemic accelerated digitization and the trend of online shopping, it has become ever more important to provide multiple consumption channels and quality shopping experiences through crossindustry  alliances. APT's  digital  stores  provide  all-round  digital  application  services,  and  through cross-industry cooperation with CVS Hi-Life and Family Mart, we have expanded to 5,100 service locations.  We  are  the  industry's  only  telecom  platform  that  takes  only  10  minutes  from  order placement to service activation and provides 24-hour service, creating the most convenient service application and shopping environment.

## ESG Sustainability Development

APT follows the international trend and echoes the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), focusing  on  operational  growth  while  integrating  its  core  5G  business  and  information  and communication technologies to incorporate ESG sustainability into its long-term strategy. In May of 2021, when the pandemic in Taiwan was starting to escalate, APT used its core business to solve social problems and sponsored 12,000 4G SIM cards for economically disadvantaged children so that they could learn without interruption. We can help the government conduct pandemic investigations and confirm the footprints of diagnosed cases through big data analysis. Meanwhile, we participated in the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP) and introduced the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures  (TCFD)  to  actively  respond  to  climate  change  issues.  APT  continues  to  improve corporate governance with high transparency of information disclosure, having been awarded the Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Award (TCSA) for two consecutive years, the Elite Award, and the Happy Enterprise Gold Award.

Domestic and international sustainability rating agencies highly recognize our ESG performance.

## Future Outlook

Taiwan's 5G era is entering its second year. Thanks to the joint efforts of the government and many industries, Taiwan's 5G industry is booming. It ranks among the leading advanced countries, a vital transformation opportunity for telecom operators with core network technologies and expertise. We foresee  more  opportunities  and  challenges  in  the  market.  APT  will  continue  to  optimize  its profitability  and  operations,  expand  its  mobile  communications  business,  and  target  emerging applications to enhance its competitiveness and capture future opportunities in the metaverse through cross-industry and cross-domain integration.

APT has signed a merger agreement with Far EasTone to use resources more efficiently. The merger will  combine  the  two's  spectrum,  increasing  the  bandwidth  to  span  4G  and  5G  connectivity  and maximizing the combined effect of the spectrum. This merger will provide consumers and enterprises with a better all-network experience and smart communication applications services for users and shareholders  alike.  This  economical  use  of  resources  can  build  a  happy  enterprise  and  promote environmental sustainability for a multi-win situation.

However, the merger is subject to the relevant procedures and the consent of the competent authorities before the finalization of the merger. Before the base date of the merger, APT will continue to maintain its original operations and continue to provide good products and services so that our customers can be satisfied to the fullest with or without the merger.

We would like to thank all the shareholders for their trust and support, and we look forward to a bright future together with you.

## Chapter2 .Company Profile

## I. Brand Vision

With a foresight into the tech trend and the tide of digital economy, Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd. has focused its business development on three dimensions, including mobile, broadband and digitalization, stridden over the traditional telecom sector and moved digital transformation ahead ever since 2014. With the "Gt Smart Life" constituting the core concept of the brand, APT has upheld the spirit of consumer preference and forged a diversified intelligent business and service portfolio. In addition to providng high-quality 4G mobile voice and network services at innovative tariffs. After embracing the 5G communication era, Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd. has  announced  an  all-new  brand  logo  -  "5G  Smart  Life,  Infinite  Possibility",  injected  three infinite forces, including quality, service and application and dedicated itself to expanding six fields, including intelligent manufacturing, energy, transport, healthcare, retail and entertainment. This  signifies  the  Gt  Smart  Life  will  go  deep  into  every  corner,  thereby  enabling  infinite possibilities and representing a future outlook from an all-new technical perspective.

- II. Core competitiveness

Asia Pacific Telecom adheres to the brand spirit of "Gt Smart Life". With quality, service and application, Asia Pacific Telecom unleashes its core competitiveness and deeply exploits the market. In terms of quality, Asia Pacific Telecom has high-quality network services, including the only high-quality dual-railway (Taiwan Railway and high-speed railway) island optical fiber backbone network,  5G  80MHz  gold  bandwidth  and  world-class  internet  speed,  high-quality stable and customized enterprise network structure. In terms of service, Asia Pacific Telecom has its close Gt Smart Life marketplaces, which offer professional consulting and diversified services. Meanwhile, it uses digital technology, aligning with over 5,000 convenience stores across Taiwan, perfectly integrating online and off-line sales outlets to provide OMO (OnlineMerge-Offline)  fully  access  services.  Asia  Pacific  Telecom  discovers  attentively  customer problems, observing them carefully and offers proactive consultation to help them. Asia Pacific Telecom cares customers, sincerely listening and enthusiastically solving customer problems, providing  high-quality  "five  heart"  spirit  service.  In  application  orientation,  Asia  Pacific Telecom has strong digital innovation and technological R&amp;D power. It has deep integration experience in the vertical field, providing end-to-end comprehensive solutions, and at the same time  brings  together  the  Group's  resources  to  continuously  expand  the  5G  ecosystem  and empower the flourishing of intelligent applications.

## 4. Diversity and Independence of Board of Directors

## (1) Diversity of Board of Directors

##  Diversification Policy

In order to strengthen corporate governance and promote the sound development of the composition and structure of the Board of Directors, the Company has established the Corporate Governance Best Practice Principles and Rules for Election of Directors, which govern the composition, qualifications and election of the members of the Board of Directors. The composition of the Board of Directors of the  Company  shall  be  diversified,  except  that  directors  who  are  concurrently  managers  of  the Company  shall  not  exceed  one-third  of  the  number  of  directors,  and  appropriate  diversification policies shall be formulated for board's operations, operating modes and development needs, such as: basic requirements and values (such as gender, age, nationality and culture), professional background (such  as  legal,  accounting,  industry,  finance,  marketing  or  technology),  professional  skills  and industry experience. The overall competence of the Board of Directors 1. Operational judgment. 2. Accounting  and  financial  analysis  capacity.  3.  Operational  management  capabilities.  4.  Crisis handling capabilities. 5.  Knowledge of the industry. 6. International market outlook. 7. Leadership. 8. Decision-making capacity.

##  Diversification situation

The Board of Directors of the Company consists of 11 directors, including 8 general directors and 3 independent directors, the directors are all nationalities of the Republic of China.The company pays attention to gender equality in the composition of the board of directors, three female directors on the board of directors,in the future, the company will continue to pay attention to gender equality in the composition of the board of directors, and strive to increase the proportion of female directors. The members of the Board of Directors have rich experience and expertise in operation, finance, business, information and communication technology, operation management, traffic management and legal, In order to continuously improve the decision-making quality of the board of directors and strengthen  the  functions  of  the  board  of  directors,  the  company  arranges  refresher  courses  for directors, so as to enhance the knowledge and ability of directors when executing business. ## (2) Independence of the Board of Directors

The  Company  attaches  great  importance  to  the  independence  of  the  members  of  the  Board  of Directors. None of the members of the Board of Directors is a director himself/herself or his/her spouse, minor children or a natural person shareholder who holds more than 1% of the total number of issued shares of the Company in the name of another person or is the top ten shareholders. There are no spouses or relatives within the second degree of kinship between the directors, and do not have matters under section 26.3 (3) and (4) of the Securities and Exchange Act.

1.Please state the policies, systems, standards, and structure for the remuneration of the Independent Directors, and state the correlation to the remuneration according to the responsibilities, risks time commitment and other factors: ：

(1) Payment policy, mechanism, and structure :

I. Pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation, the Independent Directors will receive the fixed amount of remuneration monthly, and do not engage in profit distribution.

II.Pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation, the travelling fee and attendance fee for Directors are authorized to the Board of Directors to be paid based on the normal standards in the industry.

(2) The correlation to the remuneration according to the responsibilities, risks, time commitment and other factors :

I. Fixed and monthly remuneration is adopted for Indepdendent Directors. The Independent Directors of the Company concurrently serve as the members of the Audit Committee and Remuneration Committee. The relevant disucssions and resolutions of the committees are provided for the Board's reference in decision-making. Attendance fee will be based on the number of meeting that an independent director attended.

II.The Company has conducted annual Director performance evaluation since 2019. The evaluation focuses on the director's duties, internal control, the engagement of the company operation, and further education, etc. The result will be reported to the Board of Directors to fulfill the sustainable operation and risk management.

2. Directors: Pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation, when the Company has profit in the year,

no more than 1% of the profit shall be distributed as director remuneration.However,  when  the  Company  sustains  accumulated  losses,  the profit shall first set aside to make up the loss. Independent Directors are paid with fixed monthly compensations and the Board of Directors has been delegated with the authority to propose compensations in accordance with industry standards. Independent Directors do not partake in the Company's earnings distribution.

The Directors' traveling fees are determined by the Remuneration Committee and the Board with reference to the common standards in the industry, and are based on whether they are members of the functional committees. The attendance fee is based  on  the  number  of  meeting  that  a  director  attends  the  Board  meeting  or functional committee meeting.

- Managers: Remuneration of managers include fixed pay and variable pay; Fixed pay is the monthly salary and variable pay includes annual bonus, performance bonus, and employee compensation.
- (2)Procedure for determining remuneration:
- Directors: Pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation, when the Company has profit in the year, no more than 1% of the profit shall be distributed as director remuneration. Thedistribution ratio shall be determined by a Board meeting attended by more than two thirds of directors and more than half of the attended directors approved. The result shall be reported on the Shareholders' Meeting. Independent Directors are  paid  with  fixed  monthly  compensations  do  not  partake  in  the  Company's earnings distribution.

The Directors' traveling fees are determined by the Remuneration Committee and the Board with reference to the common standards in the industry, and are based on whether they are members of the functional committees. The attendance fee is based  on  the  number  of  meeting  that  a  director  attends  the  Board  meeting  or functional committee meeting.

- Managers:Remuneration  paid  to  the  managers  of  the  Company  is  complied  with  the regulations  of  remuneration  management  and  the  common  standards  in  the industry, as well as the work responsibilities. It will be adjusted according to the Company's  operating  performance,  KPI,  and  individual  contributions.  The remuneration of the Vice General Managers and above shall be reviewed by the Remuneration Committee and reported to the Board of Directors for approval.
- (3)Correlation between operational performance and future risks:
- Director: According to the regulations of the Remuneration Committee, the performance evaluation and remuneration distribution shall consider the common standardsof the industry and focuses on the correlations of personal performance, operational performance,  and  future  risks  to  fulfill  the  sustainable  operation  and  risk management.  The  annual  evaluation  on  the  Board's  performance  focuses  on alignment of thegoals and missions of the Company awareness of the duties of a

director, participation in the operation of the Company, management of internal relationship  and  communication,  the  director's  professionalism  and  continuing education,  and  internal  control.  The  result  will  be  reported  to  the  Board  of Directors.

The  Company's  independent  directors  adopted  the  fixed  monthly  payment  of remuneration and did not receive the variable compensation. The attendance fee is  based  on  the  number  of  attendance  as  the  issuance  standard  instead  of participating earnings distribution and is not related to their operating performance.

Managers:  Annual  bonus  of  the  managers  are  connected  to  the  company  operation, department performance, and personal performance. The actual achievement will be the criteria of the bonus distribution.In addition, the Company's Remuneration Committee also  regularly  reviews  the  reasonableness  of  the  compensations  to seek  for  a  balance  between  the  Company's  sustainable  management  and  risk control.

## 3. Succession plan

Directors: In addition to the knowledge and educational background of directors, the results of the performance evaluation of directors will be taken into consideration when electing and nominating candidates for directors. The composition of the Board of Directors and the background of the members will be planned according to the development  condition  of  the  Company,  and  the  expertise  will  be  sought internally and externally to prepare for the succession planning of directors.

The Company underwent a comprehensive re-election of directors at the Annual Shareholders' Meeting in 2021. Chairman Fang-ming, Lu completed the phased task of 5G smart intelligence in the layout of Asia Pacific Telecom. In response to the multi-faceted operational development of the new 5G generation, the Board of Directors elected the new Chairman through a proposal, and Mr. Steven Chen acted as the Chairman.

- Manager: In order to cultivate key managers in the future, the Company will ensure that successors will be successfully re-elected and continued. Their management skill and strategic planning skills  will  be  further  enhanced  with  the  deputy  system, rotation system, adjustment of management scope and participation in large or operational meetings of the Company; The Company will also look for external talents to join the Company as and when required.

## 4. Implementation status

Director:  The  Board  of  Directors  of  the  Company  consists  of  11  directors  (including  3 independent directors). The election of Board of Directors adopted nomination procedures.The  9th  Board  of  Directors  is  headed  by  Mr.  Steven  Chen  as  the Chairman of the Board. He graduated from the Institute of Resource Engineering and Resource Engineering of the National Cheng Kung University. He worked in

Hon  Hai  Precision  Industry  Co.,  Ltd.  He  served  as  the  Head  of  the  General Department  of  Finance,  the  Special  Assistant  to  the  Director  of  Asia  Pacific Telecom  Co.,  Ltd,  the  General  Manager  of  Grand  Fortune  Venture  Capital Investment/Grand Fortune Entrepreneurship Management, the advisor of Hongqi Co., Ltd, and the Chairman of Wuyao Co., Ltd. He has rich experience in finance, strategic investment, telecommunications, and operational management. With the support of original technological advantages of Asia Pacific Telecom, he will lead Asia Pacific Telecom to a new milestone, creating unlimited possibilities for more 5G smart intelligence, and bringing users a better service and experience.

In  addition  to  considering  the  background  of  the  composition  of  the  Board  of Directors,  the  Company's  succession  plan  is  also  based  on  the  diversified capabilities of members in business management, industry knowledge, leadership decision-making, financial accounting, technology and other fields. During the director term, the Company took into account the changing internal and external environmental conditions of the industry and the needs of the development of the Company, and assisted in planning and arranging the directors' further training courses to enhance the professional knowledge.

- Manager:The  recent  rotation  of  the  manager  or  adjustment  of  the  management  of  the Company  is  as  follows:  Tim  Liu,  deputy  general  manager,  was  appointed  to supervise  the  network  technology  and  information  departments  in  November 2021. In November 2021, Didy Teng, deputy general manager, was appointed to supervisory business units and customer service department.

IV. Goals for enhancing the functions of the Board of Directors (such as establishing an Audit Committee or increasing information transparency) for the current fiscal year and the most recent fiscal year as well as assessments of the actions implemented:

- (I) In order to implement corporate governance and enhance the effectiveness of the Board of Directors, the Board of Directors of the Company adopted the Regulations Governing the Performance Evaluation of the Board of Directors on November 8, 2019. The annual board performance evaluation shall be conducted at the end of each year, and the external evaluation of board performance shall be conducted every three years. The performance evaluation of the Company's Board of Directors, Audit Committee and Salary Compensation Committee has been completed by the members of the Board of Directors and the deliberation divisions through a questionnaire, and the results of the evaluation have been reported to the Board of Directors on 25 February, 2022.
- (II) In order to strengthen the corporate culture and sound development of the ethical corporate management, all the Directors of the Board of Directors of the Company issued a statement of compliance with the ethical corporate management policy and signed a letter of commitment.

- (III) Two functional committees, the Audit Committee and the Remuneration Committee, have been established under the Board of Directors and formed by all Independent Directors. Each committee regularly reports to the Board to assist the Board in fulfilling its supervisory functions.

(IV) Every year, we provide diversified industry, finance, legal affairs, ESG and other course information for directors' reference from time to time, so that all members of the board of directors can maintain their core values and professional advantages and capabilities, and exert their functions to lead the company to a newer company. Governance realm.

(V) The Company files liability insurance for all Directors and staff in critical functions in each year, so that Directors and Managerial Officers are protected while implementing their duties and responsibilities, as well as to moderately reduce the Company's risks. Material contents including the insured amounts and insurance fee rates for the aforementioned liability insurance are submitted to the Board.

(VI) The  Company  discloses  relevant  information  in  accordance  with  legal  regulations  and  has  implemented  a  spokesperson  system  to  timely  and adequately disclose various material information in order to protect shareholders' rights.

(VII) The Company will also continue to focus on gender equality in the composition of the Board of Directors, ensuring at least one female director and increase the proportion of female directors.

## (II)Audit Committee Composition, Responsibilities and Operational Information

The Audit Committee is aimed at assist the Board of Directors in fulfilling its duties of supervision over the quality and integrity of the Company's implementation of accounting, auditing, financial reporting  processes  and  financial  controls.  Members  of  the  Company's  Audit  Committee  are comprised  of  all  Independent  Directors  (three  seats)  with  a  term  of  office  of  3  years,  where  all committee members will nominate one convener who will also be the chairman of the committee meetings.For the professional qualifications, experience and independence of the members of the Audit Committee, please refer to page 14, Section 2, (1), 3 'Professional Knowledge and Skills of Directors and Status of Independence'.

The main purpose of the Audit Committee is to implement supervision on the following matters:

1. Supervision over the fair presentation of the Company's financial statements.
2. Appointment (and termination), independence, and performance of the Company's CPAs.
3. Effective implementations of the Company's internal control.
4. The Company's legal compliance.
5. Management of existing or potential risks.
6. 2021 Audit Committee work summary:
1. Deliberation of the operating plan and budget in year 2021.
2. Deliberation of the annual business report and draft financial report in year 2020.
3. Deliberation of the appropriation of profit or loss in year 2020.
4. Deliberation of the supplementary explanation on the content of the issuance of common shares by the Company in the form of private placement of cash capital increase.
5. Deliberation of the statement of internal control system in year 2020.
6. Deliberation of amendments to the Code of Ethical Conduct.
7. Deliberation on the proposal to lift the restriction on directors' competition.
8. Deliberation of the Consolidated Financial Report for the First/Second/Third Quarter of 2021.
9. Deliberation of matters related to the base date and issue price of the Company's private placement common shares.
16. 10.Deliberation of the Company's intention to enter into a real estate lease contract with related parties.

## 2.Operations of the Remuneration Committee

- (1) Functions of the Remuneration Committee of the Company:

A. Establish and periodically review the performance evaluation and remuneration policy,  system,  standards  and  structure  for  the  Board  of  Directors  and Managerial Officers Assistant Manager or above, and regularly evaluate and define the remuneration of Directors, Supervisors and Managerial Officers.

- B. Regularly  evaluate  and  establish  remunerations  for  Directors  and  Managers with ranks of Assistant Manager and above.

When  the  aforementioned  functional  authority  is  performed,  the  following principles shall be followed:

- a. The performance evaluation and remuneration of directors and managerial officers  at  the  level  of Assistant  Manager  or  above  shall  be  given  with reference to the prevailing standards in the same industry and in consideration of the reasonableness of the correlation between the Company's business performance and future risks.
- b. Directors and managerial officers at the level of Assistant Manager or above shall  not  be  guided  to  engage  in  actions  that  exceed  the  Company's authorization in pursuit of higher salaries.
- c. The proportion of bonus for the short-term performance of Directors and senior managerial officers at the level of Vice President or above, as well as the time of payment of partial changed remuneration shall be determined in consideration of the industry characteristics and the nature of the Company's business.
- (2) There are three members in the Remuneration Committee of the Company, and the convener of the meeting shall represent the local representative and be responsible for convening and presiding over the meeting.

Current Term: From August 26, 2021 to August 24, 2024. In 2021 and up to the date of publication of the annual report, the Remuneration Committee has held 6 meetings (A), the qualifications and  attendance  of the  committee members are shown as follows:

## (IX) Implementation of Internal Control System

## 1.Statement of Internal Control System

Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd.

## Statement of the Internal Controls

2.

Date:  February  25,  2022

According to the examination on internal control system done by the Company itself in 2021, we hereby states as follows:

I.

II.

III.

IV.

V.

VI.

VII.

The Company's Board of Directors and management team understand their responsibilities of developing, implementing and  maintaining  the  Company's  internal  control  system,  and  such  a  system  has  been  established.  The  purpose  of

establishing  the  internal  control  system  is  to  reasonably  assure  the  following  objectives:  (a)  The  effectiveness  and efficiency of business operation (including earnings, operation performance and the safeguard of company assets); (b)

Achieve the reliability, timeliness, transparency, and compliance objectives according to the relevant laws and regulations in order to provide reasonable assurances.

Due to the innate limitation in designing a faultless internal control system, this systemcan only assure the reasonableness of the above three objectives have been fairly achieved. In addition, the effectiveness of internal control system could

alter over time due to the change of business environment or situation. Since the Company's internal control system has included self-examination capability, the Company will make immediate corrections when errors are detected.

The evaluation of effectiveness of the internal control system design and implementation is made in accordance with the

'Guidelines for the Establishment of Internal Control Systems by Public Companies' (the Guidelines). The Guidelines are made to examine the following five factors during the management and control process:(1) control environment, (2)

risk assessment and response, (3) control activities, (4)information and communication, and (5) supervision. Each factor also includes several items.Details of each factor can be found in the Guidelines.

The  Company  has  evaluated  the  design  and  operating  effectiveness  of  its  internal  control  system  according  to  the aforesaid Regulations.

The examination result indicated that the Company's internal control system (including subsidiary governance) dated

December 31,  2021  has  effectively  assured  that  the  following  objectives  have  been  reasonably  achieved  during  the assessing period: (a) The degree that effectiveness and efficiency of business operation; (b) The reliability of the financial

and related reports; (c) The compliance of the relevant laws/regulations and company policies.

This statement will become the main content of the Company's annual report and public statement and shall be open to the public. If it contains false information or omits any material content, the Company is in violation of Article 20, Article

32, Article 171 and Article 174 set forth in the Security and Exchange Act.

The Company hereby declares that this statement had been approved by the Board of Directors on February 25, 2022.

Among the 10 attending Directors, no one raised any objection to the contents of this statement.

Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd.

Chairman of the Board: Steven Chen

General Manager: Steven Chen

Where a CPA has been hired to carry out a special audit of the internal control system, furnish the CPA audit report: None.

## (VI)Dividend Policy and Earnings Distribution Implementation Status

1. Dividend Policy under the Company's Articles of Association: Cash dividend shall be no less  than  50%  of  the  total  dividend  distribution  for  the  year.  The  ratio  of  dividend distribution  and  cash  dividend  will  be  approved  by  resolution  at  the  Shareholders' Meeting based on the Company's working capital needs as well as capital expenditure plans.
2. Dividend distributions: No surplus available for distribution of dividends in 2021.
3. Explanation for anticipated material change in dividend policy: No material change in

the Company's dividend policy is expected.

Not applicable as no stock dividend was proposed in 2021.

## (VIII) Employees' Compensation and Directors' Remuneration

1. According  to  the  company's  articles  of  association ， The  Company's  Articles  of Association has stated the ratio and scope of employees' compensation and Directors' remuneration:  if  profit  is  made  during  a  year,  1-3%  shall  be  allocated  as  employee's compensations, and no higher than 1% shall be allocated as Directors' remuneration. However, if the Company has accumulated losses, it shall first reserve a certain amount for offsetting losses.

Employees' compensation in the previous item may be distributed in shares or cash, and the counterparty to whom shares or cash are distributed as employees' compensation may include the employees of its subordinate companies that meet certain criteria.

The term "profit for the current year" mentioned in Paragraph 1 refers to earnings of the pretax  benefit  of  the  current  year  deducts  employees'  compensation  and  Directors' remuneration.

Directors' remuneration shall be distributed in cash and employees' compensation may be distributed in stocks or cash. A resolution by a majority voting of the Directors present at a Board meeting attended by two-thirds or more of the Directors of the Company shall be obtained, and a report shall be submitted to the Shareholders' Meeting.

2. Accounting treatment for when the estimated amount of compensation to be distributed for  employees  and  Directors,  and  share  dividend  to  be  distributed  to  employees  and Directors for the period is different from the actual amount of distribution: no surplus was  earned  in  2021;  hence  no  estimated  employees'  compensation  and  Directors' remuneration was available.
3. Status of compensation distribution to the Broad of Directors: No surplus was available for distribution to employees or directors.
4. Employees' and directors' compensations for the previous year: No surplus was available for distribution to employees or Directors.

## VIII.Implementation of capital utilization plan

- (I) 2019 Private Common Equity Cases
1. Plan Content:

## Chapter5 .Operational Highlights

## I. Business Activities

## (I)Business Scope

## 1. Major business items:

Asia Pacific Telecom is an integrated telecommunication services provider whose primary  services  include  local  networks,  long  distance  networks,  international networks, and mobile broadband services (4G/5G).

## 2. Business proportion

In 2021, mobile telecommunications revenue accounted for 56% of total revenue, fixed  line  telecommunications revenue accounted for  18% of total  revenue, and other business revenues accounted for 26% of total revenue.

## 3. Current Products (Services):

## (1)Fixed network service

The Company's fixed network services include:

## A.Basic service:

Domestic  voice  calls,  long-distance  calls,  international  voice  calls,  cloud operator,  parallel  ring,  circular  ring,  call  waiting,  caller  ID  display,  call forwarding,  call  waiting,  three-way  calling,  automatic  hunting,  voicemail, restrict dialing numbers, anonymous call rejection, and advanced 0809 receiver payment, and 020 paid voice information and more.

## B.Short Code Service:

104/105/106 number query service, 112 trouble reporting, 117 speaking clock, 119 fire emergency call, 110 police emergency call, 166 weather reporting in Mandarin,  168  freeway  condition  information,  113  hotline  for  domestic violence,  165  anti-fraud  call,  1950  consumer  protection  call,  1968  traffic condition information, 1980 Teacher Chang guidance hotline, 1995 lifeline, 1999 hotlines for city governments, 1922 epidemic prevention hotline, 1985 consultation helpline, 1957 welfare hotline, the 1XX and 19XY special number services authorized by competent authority.

## C.Fixed Network Data Service:

Domestic  Private  Leased  Circuit,  Long  Distance  Private  Leased  Circuit, Ethernet  Leased  Line  (ELL),  International  Private  Leased  Circuit,  Internet Access Line for Businesses, FiberLink Broadband Internet Service, ADSL/FTTx  Broadband  Internet  Service,  Internet  Data  Center,  IP  Transit Service, ADSL VPN, Ethernet VPN, IPVPN Service, SSL VPN Secure Remote Access Service, etc.

## D.Network-as-a-Service (NaaS):

Unified  Load  Balancer  (ULB)  Service,  Unified  Performance  Management (UPM)  Service,  Unified  Threat  Management  (UTM)  Service,  Application Content Management (ACM) Service, Anti-DDos Service, etc.

## E.Cloud-based Service:

Enterprise  Virtual  Server  Service  (EZWeb),  Enterprise  Virtual  Mail  Server Service (EZMail), Cloud PBX Service (Cloud Centrex), Virtual Mail Backup System,  Cloud  EDM,  Enterprise  Instant  Message  Solution  (team+),  UC++ communication integration service, JadeCloud Cloud Computing Service, etc.

## (2)Mobile Telecommunication Service:

The Company introduced 4G network services in December 2014. In October 2020, 5G network service was initiated:

## A.Basic service:

Ability to dial and receive domestic calls, international calls, mobile calls, and 070 numbers.

## B.Short Code Service:

110,  119,  112,  105  directory  information  desk,  117  speaking  clock,  166 Mandarin Weather Reporting, 167 Taiwanese Weather Reporting, 168 Freeway Condition Reporting, etc.

## C.Mobile value-added service:

560  Call  answering  services,  video  entertainment,  video  learning, AI  tech fitness, e-books, smart home services, ringtones, cooking learning, anti-virus, mobile internet security, Gt Pay mobile payments, Google Play DCB, iTunes DCB, small payment collection and payment, mobile phone insurance, and online travel services due to inability to travel during the COVID-19 epidemic.

## D.Mobile Data Service:

This is the primary method for telecom service providers to increase Average Revenue  Per  User  (ARPU)  and  revenue,  other  than  voice  services.  The Company has provided the following mobile network services:

1. 4K, multi-angle, live streaming services (Gt TV)
2. AR /VR
3. High-quality voice call service (Gt VoLTE)
4. Wireless Environment Voice Call Service (Gt Vo Wi-Fi)

## (3)Smart Life and IoT Service

Differentiating  ourselves  from  industry  competitors,  Asia  Pacific  Telecom strives  to  enhance  traditional  telecommunications  services  to  Smart  life applications through integrating the resources from various partner vendors, making life smarter and more convenient. Currently, Asia Pacific Telecom has

been developing the following services step-by-step in the area of Smart life:

## A.Online subscription process optimization and O2O partnership with convenience store operators

- a. Optical Character Recognition (OCR)

The  digital  store  introduce  optical  identification  technology,  which  can quickly convert the images of ID card, health insurance card and driving license into words. Therefore, the customers can spend less time in inputting the telecom application data, improving the user experience. The image data encryption and watermark mechanism are provided, ensuring customer data to be perfectly protected.

## b. TWID authentication and identification service

We cooperate with TWCA to launch the 'Identity Service'. By combing natural person certificates or chip financial cards with computer terminals and card readers, the 'Digital Signature' can be realized online immediately. This replaces traditional paper-based autographed signature, saves logistics backhaul distribution, and greatly improves the application timeliness and achieves intelligent and paperless operations.

- c. Identification performed with convenience stores kiosks

The Identity Service is upgraded again. We cooperate with TWCA and Shin Kong Bank to launch the 'QR Code Service for Convenience Stores' and provide FamiPort machine verification channels for FamilyMart and HiLife  ET  machine  for  Hi-Life  to  enhance  the  convenience  of  'Identity Service'.

- d. O2O partnership with convenience store operators

We collaborate with Hi-Life and FamilyMart to conduct a transboundary alliance  to  shelve  the  product  'Asia  Pacific  Telecom  4G  Monthly  SIM Card'. After completing the Identity Service, customers can buy the SIM cards at the Hi-Life and FamilyMart nearby, and open the phone account immediately. The application time is successfully shortened.

## B.  FACE++ Face Recognition Service

In  recent  years,  Asia  Pacific  Telecom  promotes  the  1:N  face  recognition technology to the Taiwan market, providing financial, manufacturing and other industrial  customers  with  application  services  such  as  enterprise  personnel identification, smart absence management and non-contact access control. By taking the advantages of face recognition service and background integration, smart branch services of banks, factory personnel entry and exit management, and non-contact access control and attendance management in each field are realized.

At  present,  in  the  financial  industry  and  manufacturing  industry,  the  face

recognition system of Asia Pacific Telecom has been successfully introduced into several index customers; in addition to basic staff absence and stranger warnings,  the  two-factor  verification  access  control,  statistics  of  personnel entering and leaving the factory and other enterprise customer demands can be met through customized software development. The non-contact access control can effectively prevent epidemic, reducing the risks of disease infection caused by indirect contacts.

In light of the vigorous development of retail industry, Asia Pacific Telecom combines  human  shape  and  face  recognition  and  the  3-axis  15-analysis functions to help retailers grasp the flow of people in front of the store and inside  the  store,  the  customer  gender  and  age  and  the  proportion  of  new customers and frequent customers, which provides proprietors with accurate marketing reference. Besides, the system can provide proprietors with walking routes  of  customers  after  entering  the  store  and  hot  counters  the  customer stayed,  which  greatly  assists  proprietors  to  clearly  master  the  consumer's consumption  preferences,  so  as  to  optimize  product  display  and  increase revenue.

## C.SAFE++ Smart Security

To ensure the safety of the corporate assets and employees, we utilized AI to stream  live  videos  and  instant  identification  of  people,  events,  objects,  and behaviors. The security level is increased and is changed from passive to active protection. We focus on the manufacturing industry, retail, finance, medical and  other  smart  image  identification  scenario.  We  will  discover  more applications  while  providing  good  services  to  current  clients,  fulfilling  the smart life.

## D.SHOP++ Smart Retailing

We adopted two applications in famous chain stores in Taiwan: member facial identification for accurate marketing and customer behavior analysis. We also expanded  our  services  like  smart  customer  commercial  service,  unmanned smart equipment, O2O service, and AR/VR/MR services. We consolidated the most advanced and innovative solutions for smart retail. By maintaining the result  and  focusing  on  target  customers, APT  released  Gt  vending  machine service  that  integrated  vending  machine  vendors  and  equipment  renting suppliers, which provided a one-stop business model.

## E.FACTORY++ Smart Factory

APT assisted companies in digital transformation, accelerating the automation, digitalization, and upgrade of manufacturing factories. The main goal is to first stabilize the business by establishing a positive brand image and cooperating with  high-quality  suppliers. APT  developed  smart  manufacturing  solutions, and offered  AOI defect inspection, M2M  network, MES  production visualization,  FMCS(Facility  Monitoring  Control  System)  for  gasification

mills, AOI defect visual inspection, AGV smart moving, and smart inventory, etc.

## F. Internet of Things (IoT) Services

Asia Pacific Telecom is committed to develop IoT and creates new industrial applications to serve the corporate customers. Since the launch of IoT brand as 'IoT  by  Gt  Smart  Life'  in  Aug.  2016,  we  have  vigorously  promoted  the development and application of loT. With the services of Low Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN), 4G LTE broadband network and NB-IoT, we are a telecom company commonly selected by loT in Taiwan, as well as the first NBIoT  implementing  the  whole  coverage  in  all  six  cities.  The  Scope  of  IoT Services include:

- a. Smart Home - build home security surveillance and care service through IoT devices.
- b. Smart City - to gradually realize the objectives of smart living and smart city, Asia  Pacific Telecom  collaborates  with  private  strategic  partners  to gradually launch solutions including smart lighting, smart parking, smart grid,  and  smart  air  monitor  and  more,  fulfilling  the  government's  smart infrastructure plan and solving the needs of the public.
- c. Smart energy-As the world's Net Zero policy continues to move forward, Net  Zero  emissions  have  become  an  irresistible  global  trend.  Through Energy Bureau of the Ministry of Economy announced to set the renewable energy obligation user the green energy terms policy, Asia Pacific Telecom combines  its  own  NB-IOT  communication  strength,  communication equipment,  high-efficiency  photoelectric  panels,  and  long-term  energy storage equipment to assist customers in the planning and construction of green energy and micro-electric grids, to help customers smoothly carry out the  net  zero  transformation,  strengthening  the  ESG  policy  within  the enterprise and improve the competitive advantage of the supply chain.
- d. Smart  transportation-  Food,  clothing,  shelter  and  transportation  are  four necessities  for  the  livelihood  of  people,  and  transportation  is  the  most important  link  in  city  management.  In  recent  years,  the  Company  has actively developed AI sensing technology, and combined with the advanced technology of electric vehicles, drones, space measurements and low-orbit satellites in the industry, and used AI sensing and measurement technology to actively expand intelligent transportation solutions such as smart roads, smart  vehicles,  and  high-precision  maps.  The  Company  will  add  core critical  application  components  to  the  solution,  providing  MIH  electric vehicle applications to the affliates enterprise Foxconn Group to create a new blue ocean area.
- e. Legal enforcement assisted by technology- Technology is used in replace of labor work to deal with traffic law violation. By utilizing various equipment, automatic detection of traffic violations can be realized, along with taking photos and reporting. The Company currently provides smart cameras and

smart sideroad equipment. With AI and AI algorithms, event identification and monitoring can automatically be realized. With customized services for different units, legal enforcement assisted by technology can be realized.

## G.MobileID Identification

Together with Taiwan Network Certification (TWCA), TWCA has launched MobileID Identification, which combines a mobile SIM card with an identity system that allows online identification on mobile devices without using card reader. And for the first time, it has been applied by the Ministry of Finance and  Treasury  Resource  Center  to  the  comprehensive  income  tax  reporting exercise  in  2021  year,  providing  users  with  more  convenient  and  digital intelligent life.

## 4. Planning and Development of New Products (services):

In  addition  to  the  continued  promotion  of  existing  services,  a  number  of  new product  services  will  be  launched,  including  IoT  application  and  5G  mobile networks, etc., so as to provide fixed network users with integrated information and communication service applications.

## (1)5G Mobile Network Technology

In  October  2020,  the  Company  began  to  provide  MVNO  5G  services  in cooperation  with  FETNet  Telecom.  In August  2021,  the  Company  began  to provide  shared  frequency  and  network  service  MOCN  (Multi-Operator  Core Network) 5G services in cooperation with FETNet to provide 5G mobile network services in a more economical way for the Company and the industry. In addition, the 28GHz frequency band acquired by the 5G bidding operation with a total of 400MHz, will be mainly targeted at corporate customers or the application of specific domains and special services. And it will be constructed in accordance with the needs, and the strategic cooperation with similar industries will depend on future business development.

5G technology can be divided into the following three technical characteristics according to service and application types:

## a. Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB)

## b. Ultra-reliable and Low Latency Communications (URLLC)

## c. Massive Machine Type Communications (mMTC)

On  the  whole,  5G  emphasizes  service  applications,  and  sets  appropriate specifications through the expectation of future services.

At present, Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd. has started offering eMBB services and  and  cooperated  with  some  enterprise  customers  to  provide  5G  related application services. For instance, the low-latency service characteristics can be experienced through the MEC structure. Another instance is  the Face++ face recognition system. The low-latency service provided through MEC function has also improved the effectiveness of face recognition and realizes the recognition

with  a  very  short  time.  Furthermore,  the  Company  is  also  planning  more application services with low latency and high speed. For example, in terms of remote healthcare and unmanned vehicles, the low latency technology can be used to reduce the delay caused by the network distance, so as to improve the success rate of operation and the occurrence of accidents.

In future, Asia Pacific Telecom Co., Ltd. will evolve its 5G network from the current NSA (NonStandalone) architecture to the SA (Standalone) architecture and  also  introduce  more  related  network  equipment  and  technologies  with increased benefits, including Open RAN (ORAN) and White Box transmission equipment  to  sharpen  the  competitive  edges  of  the  Company.  The  Company expects to launch various innovative application services ahead of peers.

## (2)Smart Life and IoT

In the world of the Internet of Things (IOT), service is the most important part. Although LoRa or NB-IoT is just a connected technology, it is more important to connect  smart  devices  with  industry  applications  through  a  smart  platform  to form a complete ecosystem. Consumers can fully experience the convenience of intelligent  Life.  We  will  reinvent  our  business  model  in  the  new  year.  By combining the high transmission, low latency and high bandwidth characteristics of 5G telecommunications, we are currently developing a broadband Internet of Things  (IOT)  platform  and  an  Internet  of  Things  (IOT)  device  management platform,  conducting  connection  and  device  management  services,  and  data collection  for  customers.  In  the  future,  this  data  will  further  analyze  the fundamental data of the meta-universe for joining customers, and help them to propose a complete package of orbit-free meta-universe services before providing meta-universe services.

With the advent of 5G high-speed service and the expansion of sales to provide new services, our company will also do assessment based on the type of Internet of Things (IOT) service and the practical environment to provide solutions for the  best  application  services  in  the  future. And  actively  cooperated  with  the Affliates Foxconn Group and FHNet, so as to have the advantage to start new businesses and continue to lead the industry.

- A. Contionu to increase application fields and cultivate smart city solution. The scope includes integrated services such as high-performance environmental detectors, safety surveillance, water detection and flood prevention application, smart street lamps, smart grid, and smart campus.
- B. Continue  to  advance  IoT  by  Gt  Smart  Life  IoT  application  services  and develop more applications that better meet market needs:

a.Smart Energy: Asia Pacific Telecom launches the AIoT energy management service scheme. By introducing an integrated energy equipment management platform, we assist various fields and enterprises to achieve

electricity management, demand supervision, contract capacity optimization, electricity-saving  efficiency  promotion,  and  smart  electricity  check  and other  advantages. Then,  we  use AI  algorithm  to  sample  the  environment inside and outside the field and the electricity consumption behavior through machine  learning  technology,  independently  simulate  the  most  suitable electricity  consumption  state  and  assist  customers  to  achieve  secondary power  saving  through  automatic  control.  That  is,  the  concept  of  passive electricity  saving  via  equipment  replacement  is  transferred  to  the  active management  level,  so  as  to  assist  proprietors  to  master  active  power management of complex environmental parameters. Up to now, Asia Pacific Telecom  has  assisted  schools,  factories,  commercial  office  buildings, government agencies and other organizations to achieve the goals of efficient electricity  saving  and  electricity  management.  Moreover,  Asia  Pacific Telecom  has  totally integrated environmental  surveillance and  smart inspection based on an integrated management platform. We can not only help  customers  grasp  the  energy  usage  situation,  but  also  strengthen  the equipment  abilities  of  early  fault  alert  and  maintenance  prediction,  and reduce the costs of manpower inspection and maintenance.

- b.Smart Transportation: Asia Pacific Telecom actively carries out investment and arrangement in various fields  for  intelligent  transportation,  including analyzing  the  characteristics  and  behavior  of  people  and  vehicles  with cameras, and publishing intelligent roadside equipment to collect information on all aspects of the road. Asia Pacific Telecom also combines with  drones  and  low-orbit  satellites  to  conduct  new  applications  for AI recognition, linking the measurement industry to develop a new vision for the application of high-quality maps, integrating the expertise of partners in various  fields,  jointly  creating  optimal  solutions  for  the  transportation network.  This  will  help  transportation  authorities  to  predict  changes  and multiple  developments  in  the  transportation  network,  determining  the optimal  transportation  strategy,  and  cooperating  with  law  enforcement authorities through pre-judgment ability to achieve technological enforcement and improve law enforcement efficiency.

- (3) Smart Life and IoT

## A.Smart Life

The  Executive  Yuan  broadcasted  a  brand  video:  Digital  Taiwan  and  AI Utilization.  In  the  video,  5G  network  and AI  utilization  are  matured. This makes remote working even more accessible. The male role in the video, who originally worked in Taipei, is now able to work in his hometown remotely. Smart life includes self-driving cars, remote learning, smart healthcare, smart home, smart shopping, VR, and smart agriculture. Thanks to technology, our lives are totally transformed and we have no distance from the world.

## B.Internet of Things (IoT)

The  ICT  industry  is  accelerating  the  development  of  IoT  applications, including Industry 4.0 and smart city, both of which have generated much attention and are material scopes of IoT applications. Overall, the application service  layer  within  IoT  structure,  for  instance,  professional  vertical  fields including medical, retail, family, transportation, and energy will account for more than 50% of the revenue in total IoT applications. Businesses and the government have already sought various IoT solutions for many topics and are  strongly  committed  to  investing  in  IoT  related  services.  They  are  also integrating technical suppliers, telecommunications and transmission service providers to achieve vertical integrations to further develop and realize IoT services.

## 2. Correlation with Upstream, Midstream, and Downstream Sections of the Industry

## (1) Fixed Network and Mobile Network Services

The upstream, midstream and downstream relations within the telecom industry can basically be classified as telecom equipment supplier (upstream), telecom service  providers  (midstream),  and  channel  retails  (downstream).  The  more mature the market becomes, the more detailed the division of duty will be. Fixed network telecom service providers shall establish proprietary cable or wireless telecom networks to provide fixed line voice or data service products. They serve in a midstream telecom service supplier role in the overall telecommunications service industry. Upstream is mainly comprised of telecom industry market (e.g. NSN  or  Ericsson) formed  by  telecom equipment  companies,  while the

downstream consists of  channel  suppliers  who  facilitate  in  sales  service  (e.g. AURORA Telecom, Synnex Technology International Corp., and other smallscaled dealers).

The  comprehensive  upstream,  midstream  and  downstream  industry  in  mobile telecom industry is formed by telecom equipment producers (NSN or Ericsson), cell phone manufacturers (Apple 、 HTC 、 OPPO 、 Samsung 、 ASUS 、 vivo 、 Sony 、 Sharp 、 LG 、 realme 、 Xiaomi and more) , content service providers (mobile phone games, Autra, FTV, Pubu and Vas Creative, JSJ Music, and GaragePlay, etc.), mobile telecom company (Asia Pacific Telecom and more) and telecom channel providers (Synnex Technology and AURORA).

The  mobile  telecom  company  procures  telecom  equipment  from  equipment providers  upstream,  finishes  installation  testing  and  starts  to  provide  mobile telecom  services;  while  cell  phone  manufacturers  produce  and  provide  cell phones  that  are  compatible  with  the  telecom  equipment  for  mobile  telecom companies  and  telecom  channel  suppliers.  Content  service  providers  provide media  entertainment,  AI  technology  fitness,  e-book,  music  and  mobile  ring downloading,  and  convenient  life  applications  for  users  to  use;  Telecom operators provide accounts and  mobile  phones  to distributors. Users  or consumers  can  apply  for  mobile  services  and  purchase  phones  from  channel suppliers or directly from mobile telecom companies. ## 3. Product Development Trends and Competition Status

## (1) Mobile Network

## A.Accelerate the Development of 5G

5G is the main point of the mobile telecommunications industry development. In  October  2018,  the  Company  began  to  provide  MVNO  5G  services  in cooperation  with  FETnet.  In  August2021,  the  Company  began  to  provide shared  frequency  and  network  MOCN  (Multi-Operator  Core  Network)  5G services in cooperation with FETnet, providing 5G mobile network services in a  more  economical way for the Company and the industry. In addition, the 28GHz  band  acquired  by  the  5G  bidding  operation  cumulated  a  total  of 400MHz. This will be mainly targeted at corporate customers or the application of specific domains and special services, and will be constructed in accordance with the needs. And this will become the strategic cooperation with similar industries depending on future business development.

## B.Smartphone Specifications

As the 5G terminal technology is carrying forward, 5G phones are gradually replacing 4G phones. In addition, the specifications of smart phones continue to improve, including camera, screen, memory capacity and charging. With a screen  size  of  6  inches  as  the  mainstay  and  the  continuous  refinement  of technology, consumers have ushered in a real full-screen era. On the other hand,

front lenses and various types of sensors are fully "hidden under the screen"; foldable screens (flexible screens) are increasingly diversified. Close cooperation between mobile phone brands, professional camera manufacturers and chip dealers in lens technology has also led the development of mobile shooting to the professional level, and upgrade the moving image processing software at the same time.

## C.eSIM Cards

hrough eSIM cards, users no longer need to replace SIM cards through physical card  slots,  but  can  directly  select  telecom  providers  from  mobile  phone software,  which  greatly  increases  the  convenience.  Due  to  the  harware limitation, Apple launched LTE version of Apple Watch in 2017, which was embedded with eSIM card. The space saved assised the designers to offer more space  for  battery,  sensors,  and  other  components.  Since  the  phone  number application  process  has  been  simplified,  wearable  devices  are  expected  to become  much  more  popular.  Not  only  can  eSIM  cards  support  wearable devices, but they can also support various digital devices such as cell phones, automobiles, and home appliances. As everything is connected to the network, eSIM cards will be very fundamental..

## 4.Status of Market Competition

## (1)Analysis of Competition among Fixed Network operators

Asia Pacific Telecom is the only fixed network service provider throughout Taiwan  other  than  Chunghwa  Telecom  to  possess  underground  Taiwan Railway island-wide and THSR  fiber optic backbone network. By incorporating comprehensive Ring and Star fiber optic network structure, we have adopted leading SDH/xWDM transmission technology to provide dualrouter support, enhancing the reliability in data transmission. Asia Pacific Telecom connects all cities from the east and west coasts of Taiwan through

Multiple  Triage  and  provides  pioneering  web  management  technology  to enable  24-hour  real-time  national  surveillance,  providing  stable  enterprise data services ranging from Leased Line, FiberLink/IP Transit, to domestic, international, and cross-Strait VPN services.

The Company's Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) has been overwhelmingly  popular  since  market  launch.  To  date,  MAN  has  been adopted  by  National  Center  for  High-Performance  Computing,  Taiwan Academic  Network,  high-speed  Internet  at  various  universities,  various financial  holdings  companies  and  high-tech  companies,  propelling  Asia Pacific Telecom to a leadership brand in broadband data services. To fully cultivate  the  enterprise  data  services  market,  Asia  Pacific  Telecom  has already completed hundreds of FTTB optic buildings throughout Taiwan as well as fiber broadband network at various industrial zones and science parks. We will be committed to promoting Ethernet Leased Lines (ELL) as the basis to  subsequent adoption of network-related broadband application services, increasing the return on investment for the overall network.

Concurrently,  to  service  enterprises  in  Taiwan  as  well  as  Taiwanese companies  in  Mainland  China,  we  provide  domestic  and  overseas  VPN services  (e.g.  IPVPN/EVPN  and  Smart  VPN  applications)  by  utilizing diverse data exchange technologies including MPLS/VPLS respectively. In addition, we also provide different levels of QoS to optimize transmission quality,  simplifying  specifications  in  clients'  end  and  reducing  the  cost  of terminal equipment from clients' end. Furthermore, we have also established dedicated  enterprise  IPLC  and  IP  VPN  telecommunications  network  for cross-strait enterprises, catering to the needs of various Taiwanese companies.

To respond to market trends, we are also dedicated to developing enterprise cloud-based services, providing comprehensive and diversified cloud-based services. By integrating enterprise cloud-based services with mobile network, we can also increase client usage adhesion to promote market share.

## (3)Smart Life Market Competitive Analysis

## A.Smart Transportation Competitor Analysis

For technology in transportation, Chunghwa Telecom offers IoV, road safety monitoring, traffic light information, traffic accident alarm, traffic jam alarm, interior and exterior vehicle image, vehicle information management. FET releases  IoV  service  by  setting  a  tracking  sensor  on  a  vehicle/scooter. Through the NB-IoT network, data will be sent back to the data center. By instantly monitoring the location and traffic route of a vehicle and scooter, IoV  can  be  realized.  APT  wants  to  solve  the  issues  of  inaccurate  traffic sensors at intersections, scooter detection, and traffic management. Therefore, AI sensors for road traffic and traffic accident trigger system were proposed. Intersection  safety  cameras  were  set  to  track  the  traffic  conditions  (e.g. license  plate  numbers,  vehicle  types,  and  routes)  and  analyze  the  data,  in order to solve the problems of traffic sensors. High-speed detection on traffic accidents (traffic jam or accidents, etc.) can be implemented by connecting cameras  and  systems  with  AI  edge  computing  box,  managing  traffic condition more intelligently.

## B.Smart Energy Competitor Analysis

Chunghwa  Telecom  released  iEN  smart  energy  solution.  By  installing sensors and controllers in the end devices, operation data can be collected to monitor the environmental data including humidity and CO2. Relevant data will be collected from the clients and be sent back to iEN platform. Users can manage  their  device  information  via  the  internet  anywhere,  anytime, including the operation information, schedule, and historical data. Users are able  to  effectively  manage  their  company  facilities  and  cut  down  on maintenance costs.

FET  proposed  the  smart  energy  solution  that  assists  chain  stores,  smart buildings, and regional network to manage energy. This helps corporate users to reduce electricity cost, and split the bills. FET also provides a complete energy management system along with electricity meters and environmental sensors, which analyze energy usage and provide power-saving advice. The system can further integrate electric machinery control and renewable energy facilities to let users quickly understand the energy condition, so as to carry out effective adjustment and control. The system also features AI forecasting optimization, ISO compliance graph, and dynamic adjustment for international standards.

APT offers a smart energy service that can be divided into four stages: 1. Find

out the factor that consumes the most energy, reasons for energy waste, and energy mode by visualizing energy utilization. 2. Energy demand monitoring, understand the energy usage behavior, scenarios, and facility condition. 3. Improve unnecessary energy consumption; provide energy-saving equipment, platform management, and inspection service. 4. Demand control: Penalty for overuse; prevent energy waste; prevent the unnecessary cost. APT's smart energy service can be applied in eight aspects: Air-con management, cooling water  monitoring,  power  safety  management,  air  quality  management, electricity  management,  lighting  management,  freezer  management,  smart inspection management, etc.
